messages:
Ellen (partnerships): RackCo just flagged a delay on PO RK-33099s ETA. supplier wants to push by 10 days due to local port congestion. thoughts?
Marco (logistics): 10 days hits our EU onboarding calendar for two Dedicated customers. worst for FinTechCo.
Tina (sales): FinTechCo has compliance install window on day 5 after original ETA. they cannot move the date.
Bjorn (RackCo): apologies. port congestion and chassis shortage. we can offer a split shipment: 1 rack priority (canary) on original date, rest delayed. also offer a 5% credit or cover brokerage fees.
Yusuf (infra): priority canary only helps if firmware batch matches. Bjorn, can you guarantee contiguous firmware revs for the canary?
Bjorn (RackCo): yes. we'll tag canary serials and include CSV with fw_rev and serials.
Marco (logistics): need container IDs and provisional docs to prebook customs and trucking.
Bjorn (RackCo): container C-RK-3321 for canary ETA 2566001250, bulk C-RK-3322 ETA 2566009200. uploading docs to portal now.
portal-bot: Document uploaded: RK-3309/bol_v2.pdf by Bjorn.
Ellen (partnerships): two asks: 1) Marketplace conditional overlap for FinTechCo (no charge unless used) 2) RackCo to commit to firmware-tagged CSV and expedited BOL fix.
portal-bot: Marketplace hold available RK-MKT-EU-03 x1, token HOLD-RK3309 (72h conditional).
Tina (sales): I'll notify FinTechCo: "we have a priority canary arriving on schedule; final hardware will follow."
Marco (logistics): Action items: Bjorn upload CSV & fw map (Bjorn), Marco to prebook trucking for canary (Marco), Yusuf to prep canary image import (Yusuf), Tina to draft customer note (Tina).
Bjorn (RackCo): CSV and fw map uploaded (portal link).
Yusuf (infra): will import serials and run KV priming once CSV available. target <4h.
Tina (sales): drafting customer note now.
Ellen (partnerships): thanks all 9 react with :thumbsup: when done.
Marco (logistics): :thumbsup: trucking booked for canary.
Yusuf (infra): :thumbsup: import queued.
Tina (sales): :thumbsup: message sent to FinTechCo.
Bjorn (RackCo): :thumbsup: monitoring for bulk ETA changes.
